tips_en: Start with CO-RL (Paper 2), as its label-free multi-agent RL framework addresses a fundamental training-collapse problem in self-rewarding methods and yields broadly applicable insights across both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks. It connects thematically to Paper 1's agent-based verification gating—both leverage peer/ensemble signals to improve correctness—and to Paper 3's finding that current models (including VLMs) still struggle with deeper semantic correctness rather than surface-level metrics.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 CO-RL（第二篇论文），其无标签多智能体强化学习框架针对自奖励方法中训练崩溃这一根本性问题，提出了广泛适用于 LLM 和 VLM 推理任务的洞见。该论文与第一篇基于智能体的验证门控机制有主题上的联系——两者都利用同伴/集成信号来提升正确性，也与第三篇论文关于当前模型在深层语义正确性上仍有不足的发现相呼应。
